name: The Tribulation
overview: The Tribulation is depicted in Scripture as a period of unparalleled distress and suffering, described as a time of trouble unlike any before or after (Daniel 12:1; Matthew 24:21; Mark 13:19). It is associated with the breaking of a covenant and the cessation of sacrifices, leading to desolation and abomination (Daniel 9:27). This intense period precedes cosmic disturbances and the shaking of heavenly powers (Matthew 24:29), yet believers are assured peace through Christ, who has overcome the world despite the tribulation they will face (John 16:33).
